text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Peregrine Dedicated goes live Tue 09:00 PT. Need final checks on quota plan, autoscale, and load-tests. Runbook link (WIP): https://redwood-docs.internal/peregrine/dedicated-runbook
liam_se: Can we sync 11:30 PT tomorrow to lock traffic mix? They said short chat bursts + periodic embedding batches.
natalie_sre: I'll join. Monitoring ask: tokens/sec, queue_depth, gpu_mem_free, OOM_count. Alerts: gpu_util >85% (5m), queue_depth >200 (2m).
jordan_eng: Fallback chain: rwd-13b-quant -> rwd-13b-onnx -> rwd-7b-quant. Trigger fallback when p95 latency >1.5s. Need rollback notes if quality regression noted.
liam_se: Load test phases: steady 30m (5k rps eq) then short stress spikes. k6 script in repo. Example:```k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m scripts/peregrine_chat_profile.js```
devon_onboard: I'll run enablement Fri 15:00 PT (rate-limits, warmup, KV cache, shadowing). Jordan can you join?
jordan_eng: Yep. We'll enable prefix KV caching (customer consent recorded) to cut token cost on warmed sessions (~20-30%).
ops-bot: Reservation: reserved-dedicated-pool-peregrine (8xA100) 2025-03-25 08:00 -> 2025-04-01 08:00 UTC. Maintenance window 2025-03-26 01:00-03:00 UTC.
maria_cs: Autoscale suggestions: min=2 target=6 max=12 scale-up=60s scale-down=600s. Add soft-cap throttle at 90% to signal backpressure.
liam_se: Agree on 600s scale-down for bursty pattern. I'll finalize k6 perf targets EOD tomorrow.
natalie_sre: I'll add dashboards + pager rota and set the throttle rule before the test.
devon_onboard: Customer requested a 10% shadow mirror test. Contract has opt-in; billing mark as no-charge for shadow tokens.
maria_cs: Action items: Liam finalize scripts; Natalie add alerts/dashboards; Devon finalize enablement deck; Jordan enable KV cache and doc fallback QoS.
maria_cs: Reminder: renewal in ~6 months — flag any SLA/billing concerns during enablement. Meeting tomorrow 11:30 PT. :thumbsup:
